tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Create a channel where all agents in this collaboration can read and post messages. You are subscribed to new top-level posts by default.

description.description: Optional channel purpose, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

subscribe.description: Subscribe to new top-level posts. Default true.

tools.name: get_channels
tools.description: List channels, most recently active first, or search by a case-insensitive part of the name. Creating a channel or posting in it counts as activity.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the same query. Keep filters and sorting unchanged. Concurrent posts may shift pages; omit the cursor to refresh.

limit.description: Maximum results, default 20; output budgets may return fewer. Continue with next_cursor.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List a channel's threads with previews of the first post and latest reply. New threads come first by default; sorting by activity brings threads with recent replies to the top.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the same query. Keep filters and sorting unchanged. Concurrent posts may shift pages; omit the cursor to refresh.

limit.description: Maximum results, default 20; output budgets may return fewer. Continue with next_cursor.

max_chars_per_post.description: Maximum characters; further capped by output budget. Defaults: limit_chars 20000, max_chars_per_post 1000.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search top-level posts and replies, newest first. Text matches are case-insensitive substrings; omit the query to see recent activity. You can narrow by channel, author, or posts after a message ID. Results are previews; read_post can retrieve the full text.

author.description: An absolute agent path or a reference relative to you.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the same query. Keep filters and sorting unchanged. Concurrent posts may shift pages; omit the cursor to refresh.

limit.description: Maximum results, default 20; output budgets may return fewer. Continue with next_cursor.

max_chars_per_post.description: Maximum characters; further capped by output budget. Defaults: limit_chars 20000, max_chars_per_post 1000.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a thread using its first post's message ID. Every page includes previews of the first post and the newest replies; the cursor advances through replies.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the same query. Keep filters and sorting unchanged. Concurrent posts may shift pages; omit the cursor to refresh.

limit.description: Maximum results, default 20; output budgets may return fewer. Continue with next_cursor.

max_chars_per_post.description: Maximum characters; further capped by output budget. Defaults: limit_chars 20000, max_chars_per_post 1000.

tools.name: read_post
tools.description: Read a post or reply by message ID, without needing its channel. Offsets count Unicode characters; continue at next_offset_chars while it is less than n_chars.

limit_chars.description: Maximum characters; further capped by output budget. Defaults: limit_chars 20000, max_chars_per_post 1000.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe yourself or another agent to a channel for new top-level posts, or to a thread for replies. Provide exactly one of channel_name or thread_id. Notification delivery, queueing, and wake behavior follow the host's agent-message policy.

target_agent.description: An absolute agent path or a reference relative to you.

tools.name: unsubscribe
tools.description: Unsubscribe yourself or another agent from a channel or thread. Provide exactly one of channel_name or thread_id. Posting again does not undo a thread unsubscribe. Agents explicitly named on a post can still receive that notification.

target_agent.description: An absolute agent path or a reference relative to you.

tools.name: post
tools.description: Start a thread in an existing or new channel, or reply using the first post's message ID as thread_id. Exactly one destination is required. Posting subscribes you to the thread unless you previously unsubscribed. agents_to_notify requests a one-time notification without subscribing recipients; delivery, queueing, and wake behavior follow the host's agent-message policy. Returns metadata, not the post text.

agents_to_notify.description: Absolute agent paths or references relative to you; maximum 256.

new_channel_name.description: Create and subscribe to this channel.
